extDescription.message: Save the site you're looking at, or one image or video on it, to your criterio.design library.

lead.message: Save the site you're looking at to your library.

noteHint.message: What caught your eye? A sound, a transition, the nav… (optional)

onlyHttp.message: Only http(s) pages can be saved.

keyInvalid.message: This key no longer works. Connect again.

keyBadFormat.message: That doesn't look like a key: it starts with crit_.

disconnected.message: Disconnected. The key has been revoked.

importLead.message: Bring what you already saved elsewhere into $WS$. Each address is saved as if you had pasted it: name, thumbnail and tags come on their own.

importConnectFirst.message: Connect the extension first, then come back here.

browserLead.message: Pick the folders. Only web pages are imported; the folder names stay here.

xLead.message: Opens your bookmarks on x.com in a new tab and scrolls through them; each post found is saved here. Keep that tab open until it finishes. You need to be signed in to X in this browser.

xPermission.message: Chrome asks for permission to read x.com; it is only used while importing.

xPermissionDenied.message: Without permission to read x.com the extension can't see your bookmarks.

xNotLoggedIn.message: You're not signed in to X in this browser. Sign in and try again.

xTabClosed.message: The X tab was closed. What was found so far has been saved.

pinLead.message: Paste the address of one of your boards. Each of its pins is saved as an image, sections included. A secret board needs you signed in to Pinterest in this browser.

pinPermission.message: Chrome asks for permission to read pinterest.com; it is only used while importing.

pinPermissionDenied.message: Without permission to read pinterest.com the extension cannot see the board.

pinBadUrl.message: That is not a board. Paste the address of a board, like pinterest.com/you/board.

pinNotFound.message: Pinterest does not show that board. If it is secret, sign in to Pinterest in this browser and try again.

pinFailed.message: Pinterest stopped answering. Try again in a while.

pinPartial.message: Pinterest stopped answering halfway: $N$ new references saved. Import the board again to bring the rest; what is saved is not repeated.

pinTabClosed.message: The Pinterest tab was closed. What was found so far is saved.

pinInjectFailed.message: Could not read the Pinterest tab: $ERR$

err.example: Cannot access contents of the page

doneSaved.message: Done: $N$ new references in $WS$. Thumbnails and tags arrive over the next minutes.

nothingNew.message: Nothing new: everything was already in $WS$.

doneSavedIn.message: Done: $N$ new references in $PROJECT$. Thumbnails and tags arrive over the next minutes.

nothingNewIn.message: Nothing new: everything was already in $WS$, and now it is in $PROJECT$ too.

tooMany.message: Up to $N$ at a time: the first $N$ are imported, the rest on another run.

rightClickHint.message: Right-click any image or video to save only that.

videoPageSaved.message: This video plays in pieces, so there was no file to copy: the page and a frame were saved.
